designed_obstruction.obstruction_statement: Above u=1/3 a sufficiently large aligned timelike chi gradient makes the kinetic determinant negative even when C, Z, and the unmixed P-sector kinetic coefficient are positive.
designed_obstruction.reason_not_a_no_go: The global P function, allowed on-shell backgrounds, parameter domain, EFT cutoff, and metric constraints are not frozen; a sufficiently positive P-sector determinant can dominate on a restricted domain.

limitations: The derived system is the two-scalar principal block on a fixed external metric and constant local jets; metric perturbations, lapse/shift constraints, and disformal matter characteristics are absent.
The local jets are off shell unless separate background equations and sources are solved; no Solar, galaxy, group, cluster, or FLRW background has been established.
The u=1/3 sign flip is a serious determinant obstruction on the declared timelike slice, not an unconditional no-go theorem and not a healthy-domain proof.
The algebraic common-covector checks on aligned constant jets do not establish variable-coefficient or global strong hyperbolicity.
The deep-AQUAL X_phi->0- limit has finite longitudinal speed ratio two but vanishing principal coefficients, so strict hyperbolicity and EFT control at the transition remain unresolved.
No cutoff, gravitational constraints, universal physical-metric characteristic system, lensing law, observational support, or publication claim is established.

numeric_suite.method: direct double-precision evaluation of independently coded determinant terms at frozen dimensionless beta=1 probes

excluded_from_symbol: potential and mass lower-order terms except through the background scalar G in C and C_X
derivatives of nonconstant background coefficients beyond frozen local principal coefficients
independent_derivations: negative gradient Hessian of the exact scalar Lagrangian
highest-derivative coefficients from independent linearization of both Euler-Lagrange fluxes

scope_and_conventions.metric_role: fixed external Lorentzian metric in a local inertial patch

checks.statement: The negative quadratic gradient Hessian gives C*g^{mu nu}-C_X*v^mu*v^nu.
The chi diagonal principal tensor is Z*g^{mu nu}.
The two cross Hessian blocks are -Z_X*v^mu*w^nu and its transpose.
Independent linearization of the phi flux recovers the phi principal tensor.
Independent linearization of the chi flux recovers the chi principal tensor.
Independent flux linearization recovers both cross-principal blocks.
The Hessian and independently linearized Euler-Lagrange symbols agree.
The exact two-by-two determinant retains both background-gradient contractions.
Aligned timelike jets give the exact mixed time-kinetic matrix.
Aligned timelike jets have diagonal spatial-gradient matrix diag(C,Z).
The timelike Sylvester determinant retains the Z_X mixing penalty.
The two squared sound speeds are roots of the frozen generalized-eigenvalue polynomial.
Aligned spacelike jets retain diagonal time matrix diag(C,Z).
The transverse spatial block equals diag(C,Z).
The longitudinal spatial block contains the exact gradient mixing.
The aligned spacelike longitudinal determinant has the same algebraic form.
Z_X is differentiated exactly from Z=(1+beta*X_phi^2)^2.
Z_XX is differentiated exactly from the same frozen gate.
The chi-gradient contribution factors exactly through (1-3*u).
At chi_bar=0 with nonzero timelike X_chi, the determinant separates into the P sector plus the sign-changing gate contribution.
The apparent factorized 1/X_phi expression has a regular zero limit.
Z_X=Z_XX=0 removes principal mixing and leaves the constant-Z chi wave symbol.
For r>0, constant Z leaves the Yukawa inverse range equal to m_chi.
w_mu=0 removes cross-principal mixing and recovers the predecessor diagonal block.
For P_y proportional to sqrt(-X_phi), the spacelike longitudinal speed ratio is exactly two.
Both deep-AQUAL principal coefficients vanish at X_phi->0- despite their finite ratio.
dt evaluates to minus the positive kinetic form and is an algebraic common time covector when Sylvester conditions hold.
dt evaluates to minus diag(C,Z) on aligned spacelike jets.

local_Taylor_jet_basis.interpretation: F1,F2,Z1,Z2 are arbitrary first and second derivative values at the local jet, so the principal result is general for twice-differentiable F and Z.

transition_and_regressions.X_phi_to_zero_deep_AQUAL: P_y proportional to sqrt(-X_phi) makes the phi time and longitudinal coefficients vanish at the boundary, so strict hyperbolicity/weak coupling is not established there even though the limiting longitudinal speed ratio is 2.
transition_and_regressions.X_phi_to_zero_regular_P: Z tends to 1, Z_X tends to 0, the apparent 1/X_phi obstruction form has the regular limit zero, and a regular P_y(0)>0 yields a decoupled nondegenerate external-metric scalar symbol.
transition_and_regressions.algebraic_physical_metric_precheck: A>0 and 1-2*d_phi*X_phi/M_phi^4>0 retain a local Lorentzian physical metric and the aligned dt covector where the scalar Sylvester conditions pass; the full disformal matter/metric characteristic system is not derived.
transition_and_regressions.chi_gradient_zero: w_mu=0 removes cross-principal terms and returns the predecessor diagonal constant-background result.
transition_and_regressions.constant_Z_Yukawa: Z_X=Z_XX=0 removes principal mixing; chi has symbol Z*k2, the lower-order mass is Z*m_chi^2, division by constant Z keeps inverse range m_chi and rescales only the source amplitude by 1/Z.
